cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Allen-Bradley Company, Milwaukee, Wisconsin, 1960; Bradley Family Foundation, Milwaukee, Wisconsin, gift, 1969 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Completed after move to San Antonio, on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. The relationship between this work and photographs by Stieglitz and Paul Strand that O'Keeffe knew through *Camera Work* was first published by Sarah Greenough in *Art and Letters* (1987), pp. 276–277, nn. 17–18. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
